scripts.dev: vite build && concurrently -k -n build,pages,test -c blue,green,magenta "vite build --watch" "wrangler pages dev --live-reload" "vitest watch"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vitest run && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-typegen && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy
